title: Team messenger where assistants report and ask before acting
lead: A self-hosted team chat where automated assistants post their status and ask you with buttons before they act.

hero.caption: A team room on a computer: an agent hands work over as a card — done, next, files (interface in Russian; names blurred).
hero.alt: A team room on a computer: an agent hands work over as a card — done, next, files (interface in Russian; names blurred).

problem: A team where part of the routine is done by automated assistants (programs that check warehouse stock, collect orders, prepare reports) needed one place to see what each assistant is doing and to answer it, instead of digging through email and different windows.
built: Familiar chats: direct messages and group rooms, voice messages, photos, documents, search.
Cards instead of walls of text: an assistant posts working, done or failed; asks a question with buttons ('Send buyers a reminder? Send / Wait') and acts only after your answer.
You stay in control: invite-only sign-up, an owner panel unlocked with a code from the owner's phone, an activity log, and a daily backup of the data.

steps: An assistant posts a status card to a room.
When it needs a decision it asks with buttons.
It acts only after your answer.
Everything is logged, and the data is backed up every day.
offer: Installing the messenger (it is called Zokul) on your server (if you have none, I will advise what to rent).
Connecting one of your assistants: it posts to the chat and asks you with buttons.
You own the code and the access after handover, with a short guide.
New assistants built around your data are a separate stage, scoped from your brief.
not_included: Hosting, domain and third-party service fees.
